method: open -a Apps; window owned by the Siri process (layer 23, not in AX); screencapture -l -o for shapes (alpha) and pixels; window-local pt unless noted

search_bar.fill: dark (6,6,6 raw) in light and dark mode
search_bar.glyph: App Store (A) 26.5x23.5 at x 194.5 (32.5 from the bar left)
search_bar.ellipsis: 17.5 wide at x 627 (37.5 from the bar right)

panel.material: glass over the desktop (raw window fill 16,16,16)

chips.note: list depends on the installed apps; scrolls horizontally
chips.y: 117..143 (20 below the panel top), h 26, r 13

grid.top_row: 7 suggested/recent apps (icons y 167..227), then a 1 pt separator at y 265 (x 20..824, +35 lighter), then all apps A-Z from y 284
grid.label: SF 13 pt regular, white, centred, cap top 11.5 pt below the icon, truncated with "…"
grid.keyboard: arrows move an accent focus ring: 69 pt squircle around the 60 pt icon, about 3.5 pt thick

search.typing: "cal" -> field shows "cal — Open" (completion chip), grid filters in place (same 7 columns), panel keeps its size, first result on a grey 68 pt plate

category.click: category becomes a token in the field ("Utilities"), chips row disappears, grid of that category starts at the panel top; includes iPhone apps (small phone badge); order not alphabetical

launch: clicking an app or Return launches it and the panel closes
escape: 1st Esc: the Apps panel goes away in one frame and the plain Spotlight bar ("Search or Ask" + mic) stays; 2nd Esc closes it. Reopening soon after keeps the last query.
scroll: vertical list, no pages/folders/edit mode seen; synthetic wheel events did not scroll it (not verified)
